description: Delney, Streetwise Lookout + Runic Armasaur: Runic Armasaur's 'may draw' opponent-activated-ability trigger is a power-2 creature's triggered ability, so Delney doubles it. Both independent instances offer the controller their own optional draw choice; this fixture demonstrates accepting both. Validates INT-0009.
artificial_state_elements: Mishra's Factory + Wastes for playerB were chosen as an arbitrary source of a non-mana land activated ability with no target - any qualifying non-mana creature/land ability triggers Runic Armasaur identically.
No other permanents, hand cards beyond what's listed, or players' boards were modeled.
material_characteristics: Runic Armasaur's power is exactly 2, so its own triggered ability qualifies for Delney's power-2-or-less doubling clause

Runic Armasaur's trigger is 'you may draw a card' - an optional ability where the choice belongs to Runic Armasaur's own controller, distinct from Esper Sentinel's (INT-0008) opponent-controlled pay/decline choice
Delney's static ability produces two independently-resolved instances, each offering its own separate 'may draw' choice
abstracted_characteristics: Identity of the specific non-mana land/creature ability activated (any qualifying activation triggers Runic Armasaur identically)
All board state not directly involved in the two-permanent interaction

legal_actions: Seat 2 activates Mishra's Factory's '{1}: becomes a 2/2 Assembly-Worker' ability
illegal_actions_to_reject: Any implicit assumption that Runic Armasaur's draw only fires once (Delney alone) rather than twice, each independently offering the controller a 'may draw' choice
Modeling the two instances as a single 'may draw 2' choice rather than two separate optional decisions
expected.outcome_if_resolved: After seat 2 activates Mishra's Factory and seat 1 accepts both independent 'may draw' choices: seat 1's hand grows from 0 to 2 cards.

rules_citations: CR 603.2d (a triggered ability may be stated to trigger an additional time; determine how many times, then trigger that many times)
CR 603.3b (a player puts each of their own simultaneously-pending triggered abilities on the stack in any order they choose)
